title: No Poverty
question: Is a person in India protected when income stops?

india_ind.label: Social protection coverage
india_ind.source: MoSPI, National Indicator Framework Progress Report 2026

reading: India's own social protection coverage now runs well above the world figure, having tripled in ten years.

title: Zero Hunger
question: Are Indian children getting enough to grow?
reading: India's child wasting rate is close to three times the world figure and is the worst recorded on earth. This is the single hardest number on the register.

title: Good Health and Well-being
question: How many mothers die giving birth in India?

india_ind.label: Maternal mortality ratio
india_ind.source: MoSPI, National Indicator Framework Progress Report 2026

reading: Two competent sources give India two different figures for the same indicator over overlapping years, and neither discloses the other.

title: Quality Education
question: Do children finish school, and can they read when they do?
reading: India's education score moved four points. The world figure that matters more is that under six in ten primary pupils anywhere reach minimum proficiency in reading.

title: Gender Equality
question: How many girls are born, and who holds the power?

india.note: the lowest score of any goal in India

india_ind.label: Sex ratio at birth
india_ind.source: MoSPI, National Indicator Framework Progress Report 2026

world.label: Seats held by women in parliament
world.note: progress slowed to 0.3 points in a year

world.label: Women in management
world.note: parity is roughly 100 years away at this rate

world.label: Married before 18
world.note: nearly one in five young women

reading: Gender equality is the only goal on which India scores below 50. The sex ratio at birth is rising, but from a floor that should not exist.

title: Clean Water and Sanitation
question: Can a household turn a tap and drink what comes out?

world.label: Water stress, Central and Southern Asia
world.note: critical, and the lowest use efficiency in the world

reading: India's own score is one of its highest. The region it sits in carries the world's most critical water stress, and the two facts have to be read together.

title: Affordable and Clean Energy
question: Is the power reaching people, and where is it coming from?

india_ind.label: Renewable capacity per person
india_ind.source: MoSPI, National Indicator Framework Progress Report 2026

world.label: Installed renewable capacity per person
world.note: world record, India named a driver

reading: India tripled renewable capacity per person in eleven years and is named by the UN as one of three countries driving world capacity growth.

title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
question: Is there work, and is it worth having?

india_ind.label: Unemployment rate
india_ind.source: MoSPI, National Indicator Framework Progress Report 2026

world.label: Young people not in work, education or training
Young women not in work or education, this region

reading: India's headline unemployment sits below the world figure. The regional figure for young women, at 41.9 per cent, is the one that should be read next to it.

title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
question: Who is connected, and to what?

india_ind.label: Internet subscriptions
india_ind.source: MoSPI, National Indicator Framework Progress Report 2026

reading: Internet subscriptions in India more than tripled in ten years. The comparator for this goal has not been ingested and the cell stays blank until it is.

title: Reduced Inequalities
question: Is the bottom rising faster than the top?

india.note: the only goal on which India's score fell

world.label: Labour share of GDP
world.note: down from 52.9% in 2015, about $255 per worker lost

world.label: Reported discrimination in the past year

reading: This is the only goal on which India's own index score went down. Worldwide, productivity gains are not reaching wages.

title: Sustainable Cities and Communities
question: Can a city household afford a decent place to live?

world.label: Living in slums or informal settlements
world.note: up to 3 billion struggle to afford housing

reading: India's index score on cities more than doubled since 2018, while the international assessment still classes this goal a major challenge for India.

title: Responsible Consumption and Production
question: How much does the country consume to produce what it produces?
reading: No admissible figure has been ingested for either India or the world. The international assessment reports the direction as worsening, and that direction is all this register will assert until it has a number.

title: Climate Action
question: What is each Indian emitting, and what is the planet doing?

india.note: India's largest single improvement, up 13 points

world.label: Temperature above pre-industrial
world.note: 2024 was the hottest year on record

reading: India's index score rose more on this goal than on any other, while its emissions per person reached a record high. Both are true and the register publishes both.

title: Life Below Water
question: What is happening to the sea along 7,500 kilometres of coast?

india.note: excluded from India's composite, computed for coastal states only

reading: Nothing admissible has been ingested. India's own index excludes this goal from its national composite, which is itself worth knowing.

title: Life on Land
question: How much forest is left, and how fast is it going?

world.label: Forest lost each year
world.note: down from 12 million a year in 2010 to 2015

reading: India's score on land rose nine points, while the international assessment still classes this a major challenge. The Indian forest figure has not yet been ingested.

title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
question: How safe is a person, and can they be seen by the state?

world.label: Conflict deaths
world.note: one life every 12 minutes, up 40% on 2023

reading: On present trends the world homicide rate will fall 25 per cent by 2030 against a target of 50 per cent. India's own figure has not been ingested.

title: Partnerships for the Goals
question: Who is online, and who is paying for the rest?

world.label: Official development assistance
world.note: down 7.1% in real terms, expected to fall further

world.label: Debt service, lower and middle income countries

reading: Two thirds of humanity is online. Development assistance fell for the first time in years, and debt service reached a record.
